definition: a flat metal dish with a long handle
description: At a desert campsite at dusk with pink clouds and red rock buttes behind, a bearded young man in a cream jacket crouches by a campfire and reaches up as a black cast-iron frying pan and a pancake fly high above him. A young woman in a knitted cardigan walks up holding another pan; the pancake drops towards her, and she then lifts her pan high and cheers while he holds his own pan again. Friends sit near white bell tents, beside a table with a bowl of batter and a stack of pancakes, and a dog watches.
